3. The Board deferred disposition of the following cancellation hearing held on September 30, 2025:
Huntington Market, Inc. d/b/a Huntington Liquors, located at 303 Huntington Av., Boston, MA 02115
License#: LB-101894, Notice/Violation#: CANCELLATIONHEARING, Category: RETAL
Date: 08/29/2025 Notice: The Board held a mandatory informational hearing on August 26, 2025 at
which the Licensee was put on notice of the potential cancellation of the License due to the Licensee’s
lack of legal right to occupy the Licensed Premise, the filing of the annual renewal application for the
Licensee entity, and the non-use of the License in violation of M.G.L. ch. 138 s. 16A, s. 23, s. 64, s. 77;
and Board’s Rule 1.07A, 1.07I, 1.15A(3), 1.15A(4).

The Board will not allow the Licensee to renew the license at this location for 2026.
The License will be canceled on December 31, 2025 unless the Licensee files an application to
transfer or relocate the License prior to that date.
